documented_probe: C-18b56bb0 (aggregate streamed JSON records: per-tag counts and rounded currency sums): reference floor is easy; this task exercises it at easy with full hidden-case coverage.
notes: Single-stage: parse a JSONL tip stream, tally per-tag counts and sum amounts rounded to 2 decimal places, count skipped/blank lines. Failure mode targeted: unrounded floats (e.g. 0.30000000000000004) or integer-serialized integral sums (10 instead of 10.0) fail the verifier's precision and type checks. Small nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (skip classification + rounding rule), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases: float drift, empty file, all-malformed, integral float), and quantitative_correctness (exact ints and rounded floats). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.
